title: Two Men Bound Over for Trial in Nuevo Laredo Weapons Case
excerpt: Two men were bound over for trial in Nuevo Laredo after soldiers seized 12 firearms, more than 2,200 cartridges and tactical gear, Mexico's federal prosecutor's office said.
content:
Two men detained in Nuevo Laredo were bound over for trial on charges of stockpiling firearms reserved for the armed forces, Mexico's Attorney General's Office said Tuesday.

Carlos "N" and Christopher "N" were detained in recent days by soldiers from the Secretariat of National Defense in the Arboledas neighborhood, according to the federal prosecutor's office. A federal judge found the detention lawful and ordered the two held in preventive detention at the Nuevo Laredo state prison while the investigation continues.

Soldiers seized two rifles, 10 firearms, 92 magazines, 2,256 cartridges, five tactical vests, three anti-fragment helmets and 10 ballistic plates in the operation, the prosecutor's office said. Prosecutors have three months to complete the complementary investigation.

The two men are presumed innocent until a court hands down a conviction, the prosecutor's office said.

Sources: Fiscalía General de la República (FGR), Comunicado 841/26, Nov. 24, 2026.
